body:
## Parent

#36 (Spec: Lexicon v0)

**Milestone:** M0  
**User stories:** 17, 18, 19  
**Test seam:** live app (harness and test fields)  
**Modules:** AppText

## What to build

Insert by putting the text on the pasteboard and sending Cmd-V, then restore Jake's clipboard Handy-style: pasteboard promise, the target's read counts as a receipt, restore after 200 ms of no reads, checked against `changeCount`, 8 s cap. Layout-aware V keycode; fn released before Cmd-V; never report success on a silent fallback. No Accessibility insertion and no simulated typing as the main path.

- Set `AXManualAccessibility` on the frontmost app when it activates (Electron apps like Claude desktop need it), not at insert time.
- Store an insertion receipt (app, field fingerprint, caret, short context) in History.
- Start from Handy's reliable paste and Muesli's paste controller (harvest list, MIT) with copyright lines.
- Check whether restoring the clipboard makes macOS ask for permission; report what actually happens so Jake can decide before M1.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Text lands correctly in the Claude desktop app, ChatGPT (Codex), a native text field and Terminal.
- [ ] Jake's previous clipboard is back after each paste.
- [ ] Lexicon's own work from fn-up to Cmd-V is 10 ms or less.
- [ ] The clipboard-permission question is answered with what macOS does.

## Blocked by

- #45
